nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Face Wash

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including a 12-year-old with sensitive, acne-prone skin and adults, report the wash cleans without irritating or drying their skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it cleans without over-drying and leaves skin soft, with one pairing it with Moisture Surge for added dryness relief.
segments.oily: One reviewer used it to remove facial oil and reports skin feels very clean afterward, and another notes it leaves skin clean without feeling oily.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe skin that was previously dried out (from hand soap or other cleansers) and report the wash cleans without drying, leaving skin soft and comfortable.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including a preteen, report no irritation and describe the product as gentle on sensitive skin, with no dissent noted.
concerns.spots: One reviewer bought it for a 12-year-old with mild acne and sensitive skin and reports a visible difference overnight; another adult reports the wash does not cause breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the wash deep cleans without breaking her husband out, consistent with the acne-related improvement reported for the 12-year-old.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers report the wash removes facial oil and leaves skin feeling clean rather than oily after use.

aspects.libelle: Good lather with small amount needed

extraits.texte: I bought this for my 12-year-old son who has mild acne issues, but also has sensitive skin. We could see a difference overnight!

extraits.titre: Amazing face wash very gentle to the skin.
extraits.texte: Great product that does the job. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate my skin and is very gentle. I use this face wash with the moisture surge hydrator and works wonders for my dry skin.

extraits.titre: I will never use anything else again.
extraits.texte: I was using the charcoal face wash prior to using this one. I loved the charcoal but I always felt as there was a film of soap on my face like I didn't wash it off completely, when I did. I love how this face wash is clear and fragrance free, which is awesome if you have allergies and any heavy fragrance makes you stuffier. You don't need much, I use roughly a dime sized amount. Because of that, you get longer use out of the face wash. It doesn't dry skin out and makes it soft.

My husband used to wash his face with hand soap when he washed his hands, and it was causing his face to dry out so bad! He agreed to try this product instead of hand soap, and liked it so well he now asks me to buy it again when he's running low! It has a great lather, doesn't dry his face out, not overpowering, and I don't think it has a smell to it on his face. This is literally the only product I can get him to wash his face with.
I used this to clear my face. It helps to remove the face oil. It makes my skin feel very clean.
My husband has never been particular about face wash, but he LOVES this! It deep cleans his face, without over drying or breaking him out! Highly recommend!

extraits.titre: This is a staple for my husband
extraits.texte: He uses it everyday. Keeps his skin clean and smooth. Gentle on his sensitive skin.

reserve: Most reviews are written by third parties (wives/fiancées) about a male user rather than by the person with the skin, and few give concrete before/after detail, so conclusions rest on a small subset of informative reviews.
